description: Machine-readable record of (a) high/critical npm audit findings that are deferred rather than fixed (read by scripts/check-dependency-audit.js), (b) known-safe matches for the repo secret scanner (read by scripts/scan-repo-secrets.js), and (c) approved exceptions for container image CVEs found by Trivy. See docs/dependency-triage.md, docs/security.md, and docs/container-security.md for the respective processes.

container_scan_exceptions._comment: Each entry in the 'entries' array represents an approved exception for a container image CVE found by Trivy. Required fields: cve_id (e.g. 'CVE-2024-12345'), image (e.g. 'paymentflow/backend' or 'paymentflow/frontend'), owner (name and email of the person who raised the exception), expires (ISO date, max 90 days from creation — set to 'EXAMPLE-REMOVE' on example entries), justification (why this cannot be fixed immediately and why the risk is acceptable), risk_accepted_by (name of the engineering lead or security officer who signed off). Expired exceptions are not honoured — the build will block again until renewed or the CVE is fixed. Also add the CVE to .trivyignore to prevent the workflow from failing while the exception is active.

entries.justification: THIS IS AN EXAMPLE ENTRY — REMOVE BEFORE USE. Replace with the real CVE ID, affected image, a genuine justification, and a real expiry date no more than 90 days from today.
